caption:
A Sunday night without the scroll: one flower page, a cup of tea and nowhere to be. 🌸

These are four of the 250 pages in my Vintage Flower book, inspired by classic botanical illustrations. Big open blooms, layered petals, long loose stems. I'd save the full bouquet for last.

The outlines are clean and black, so your pencils, markers and fine liners all work, and every page is single-sided. If you're new to coloring, you can finish a page tonight. If you've been at it for years, there's still plenty here.

Every page is US Letter 8.5 x 11 in at 300 DPI. You'll get a print-ready PDF plus 250 JPG and 250 PNG files, and you can print as many times as you like.
